title: Student projects and what they left in the code
description: Projects from ZAP's Student Hall of Fame, 2012 to 2023, next to the commits and add-ons in the repositories.

chapters.title: 2012: WebSockets, the Ajax spider and a crawler redesign
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame lists three 2012 Summer GSoC projects: WebSocket testing (Robert Koch), Ajax Spider (Guifre Ruiz) and a crawler redesign with session support (Cosmin Stefan). A commit dated 2012-05-07 reads "create branch for my GSoC project: Enhancing ZAP with WebSockets". On 2012-06-22 a commit by guifre is "modifications needed to run the ajax spider". The crawler work shows as "New SpiderParam in org.zaproxy.zap.spider..." (2012-05-29) and "Removed old and unused Spider-related Paros Proxy packages" (2012-07-12).

chapters.title: 2013: reporting, Zest, HTTP sessions and SAML
chapters.text: The 2013 Summer entries are BIRT Reporting (Rauf Butt), Zest enhancements (Alessandro Secco), Enhanced HTTP Session Handling (Cosmin Stefan) and SAML 2.0 support (Pulasthi Mahawithana). The commit "BIRT Reporting with XML data source and Scripting - GSoC 2013 by Rauf Butt" is dated 2013-10-09. Zest work appears as "ZestLoopFile UI + SurroundWith + get/add to Fuzzer Files" (2013-08-12), and "Added SAML extension's initial code for alpha release" is dated 2013-09-05. The earliest commit titled "Initial version of http sessions handling." is dated 2012-08-03.

chapters.title: 2014: multi-fuzzing and SOAP scanning
chapters.text: For 2014 Summer the page lists Advanced fuzzing (Sebastian Schulze), SOAP scanning (Alberto Verza) and Advanced Access Control testing (Cosmin Stefan). The commit "Core packages for multi-fuzzing." is dated 2014-06-04, and "WSDL file import Add-On." 2014-04-30.

chapters.title: 2015: the DOM XSS scanner
chapters.text: The Hall of Fame credits Aabha Biyani with the DOM XSS Scanner (2015 Summer, directly mentored) and links the DOM XSS add-on. The add-on's first commit in zap-extensions, "DOM XSS Active Scan rule", is dated 2015-08-21 and was made by psiinon (Simon Bennetts), so the code reached the repository through a core-team member.

chapters.title: 2016 to 2018: bug tracker, form handling, the HUD and an authentication helper
chapters.text: Sanchit Kapoor's Bug tracker support (2016 Summer, GSoC) shows as "Added help for Bug Tracker add-on" (2016-08-27). Three students (Ryan Wehe, Christopher Laguna, Rian Franey) are listed for form handling in Mozilla Winter of Security 2016; the commit "Form Handler Extension" by Ryan Wehe is dated 2017-03-22. David Scrobonia's ZAP HUD (2016 to 2018, directly mentored) lives in its own repository, zap-hud. In zaproxy, the commit "Include the HUD add-on in live Docker image" (2018-12-05) builds it from source into the live Docker image, and "Fix Docker live image" (2019-06-10) removes that step. "Add main add-ons" (2019-06-07, the date of release 2.8.0) lists the HUD, version 0.4.0, among the add-ons bundled with ZAP. The HUD is still in the main add-ons list in release 2.17.1 and at the current head, at version 0.19.0. Kajan Mohanagandhirasa's Authentication helper (2018 Summer) is listed. The zaproxy history has pull requests from the GitHub user KajanM merged between 2018-05-28 and 2018-08-28, among them #4682 (dynamic-token-authentication), #4696 (renew-cookie-before-each-login) and #4946 (add-new-default-acsrf-token); a commit by kajan on 2018-05-21 is "support acsrf token in post-based authentication".

chapters.title: 2018 and 2019: scanning WebSockets
chapters.text: Manos Kirtas is listed for Scanning websockets, phase 1 (2018 Summer) and phase 2 (2019 Summer). The commit "WebSocket regex & non-regex filter #1382 (#1506)" is dated 2018-04-27 and "[WS-Passive-Scan] Infrastructure & Passive Script Plugin" 2019-07-04. In 2019 Nirojan Selvanathan is also listed for the ZAP API documentation (Season of Docs), which is kept in the separate zap-api-docs repository.

chapters.title: 2020 and 2021: GraphQL, out-of-band testing and retesting
chapters.text: Akshath Kothari is listed for GraphQL Support (2020) and for Out-of-band Application Security Testing (2021). The graphql add-on's first commit "Initial commit" is dated 2020-05-21, and "oast: Initial commit" 2021-06-18. Pranav Saxena's Retesting Alerts (2021) starts with "Initial addon" on 2021-08-20. Nirojan Selvanathan's ZAP GitHub actions work (2020 Spring, directly mentored) is listed with two blog posts.

chapters.title: 2022 and 2023: Param Digger, the browser recorder and Postman
chapters.text: Arkaprabha Chakraborty's Param Digger (2022) begins as "Add initial param miner extension" (2022-06-02), then "Add refactorings to change paramminer to paramdigger" (2022-08-21). In 2023 Aryan Gupta (Browser Recorder) and Vitika Soni (Postman Support) are listed; the commit "Add Postman add-on" is dated 2023-06-03, and Aryan Gupta's "zest: add dialogs for new client statements (#4698)" 2023-07-05. The page states ZAP was not selected as a GSoC mentoring organisation in 2024.
